healthy_wheat.immediate_steps: Monitor the plant regularly and keep leaves dry where possible.
healthy_wheat.treatment: No treatment needed. Keep balanced watering and feeding, and remove any dead leaves promptly.
healthy_wheat.prevention: Give good air circulation, avoid overwatering, and check leaves weekly so any new problem is caught early.
healthy_wheat.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

wheat_brown_rust.immediate_steps: Remove infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering.
wheat_brown_rust.treatment: A fungicide labelled for this crop and disease may help — always follow the product label and local agricultural advice. Organic options such as sulphur or neem-based sprays are used for some fungal diseases.
wheat_brown_rust.prevention: Water at the base, space plants for airflow, rotate crops, and clean up fallen leaves.
wheat_brown_rust.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

wheat_septoria.immediate_steps: Remove affected leaves and monitor whether the problem spreads.
wheat_septoria.treatment: Identify the exact cause first — treatment depends on whether it is fungal, bacterial, viral or a nutrient issue. Seek local agricultural advice if it spreads quickly.
wheat_septoria.prevention: Keep plants well fed and watered, improve airflow, and check leaves regularly.
wheat_septoria.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.

wheat_yellow_rust.immediate_steps: Remove severely infected leaves, improve air circulation, and avoid wetting leaves when watering. Check the flag leaf first, as it matters most for yield.
wheat_yellow_rust.treatment: A fungicide labelled for wheat yellow rust may help — for example propiconazole or tebuconazole, always following the product label and local agricultural advice. Apply at the first sign of yellow stripes.
wheat_yellow_rust.prevention: Use rust-resistant wheat varieties where available, avoid late sowing, scout weekly in early spring, and remove volunteer wheat plants.
wheat_yellow_rust.note: General guidance only. For chemical use, always follow the product label and local agricultural extension advice.
